title: Ideal customer profile
description: Who the venture serves (EE-051), at <venture>/purpose/icp.json: the 'who' foundation statement. One or more profiles, one primary, each specific enough to go and find ten of them, with what they are trying to do, what gets in the way and who is out of scope. Gated like the telos: an agent's write is a draft the founder accepts.

decision.description: The decision that set it, such as EE-045

who.description: Who they are, specifically enough to find ten of them

short.description: One line naming who they are; the venture's promised-to statement shows it (EE-052)

phases.description: The phases of their own venture they are in, when they are founders

traits.description: What must be true of them

jobs.description: What they are trying to get done (jobs to be done)

problem_forms.description: Ids of the problem record's forms they have

where_to_find.description: Where to reach them: communities, channels, events

not.description: Who is out of scope, and why

buying_roles.description: The parts this profile plays in a purchase (the buying center: Webster and Wind 1972; initiator added by Bonoma 1982). One person may hold several; a solo founder or a consumer usually holds them all.

reached_through.description: Other profiles (ids) through whom the venture reaches this one, such as a channel partner in a B2B2C venture (EE-064)

customer_type.description: The customer type from the marketing matrix (operations/marketing/site/matrix.json customer_types), when the founder sets it; otherwise it is judged from who (EE-063)
